profile.headline: Phantom Works Software Engineer at Boeing

positions.title: Phantom Works Software Engineer
positions.description:
Contribute to all phases of the software development life-cycle (requirements, architecture, implementation, & verification).
Work in small to medium sized agile teams composed of diverse engineering skills to tackle complex problems on a variety of projects & features.
Responsible for developing technical products, plans, documentation, & briefings in support of program requirements.

positions.title: Simulation Lab Software Engineer
positions.description:
Aid with the development, documentation, & company showcase events.
Direct the maintenance of algorithms, interfaces, & UI designs for simulation & lab software.
Support the onboarding process for new team members.
Pioneer test procedures to ensure software requirements are met.
Redesign documentation for various software solutions.
Develop efficient algorithms in C++ through pair-programming.
Pioneer python scripts to meet software goals.
Received multiple pride recognitions for various projects.

positions.title: Consumer Authentication Solutions Intern
positions.description:
Supervised teams to improve the production.
Assembled reports & documents for planning future projects.
Directed teams to improve efficacy & ensure quality code.
Maintained team objectives each sprint.
Enhanced the internship experience with various workshops & surveys.
positions.insights: Windows OS, Cross-team Collaboration and +6 skills

positions.title: Cyber Security Research
positions.description:
Constructed a new software application to combat hacking attempts (CAIR-T).
Supported the onboarding process for new team members.
Illustrated reports & composed videos on various software applications.
Analyzed penetration testing protocols using Mutillidae, Metasploitable 2, & Kali Linux.
Studied the beginner level of Cyber Security & Network Security.
positions.insights: Windows OS, Cross-team Collaboration and +13 skills

positions.title: Cyber Security Research
positions.description:
Collaborated a detailed installation process for Root the Box.
Generated virtual machines using Ubuntu to become familiar with NIDSs & HIDSs.
Constructed reports & demonstrated videos on Security Onion & Osquery to present the findings.
Utilized the teachings from The Hacker Playbook 2 to be introduced to attack tools & implementations.
Expanded knowledge of penetration testing protocols on Mutillidae, DVWA, & Metasploitable 2 with Kali Linux.
Completed independent assignments on edX: Cybersecurity Fundamentals, Network Security, & Introduction to Python: Absolute Beginner & Fundamentals.
positions.insights: Windows OS, Cross-team Collaboration and +13 skills

volunteerExperiences.description:
Participant/walker of the March to Memphis: 50 miles for 50 years
Mentor to educate high school students about civil rights & promoting racial & economic justice.
Encourage & cast a vision towards excellence in life, & as a man of righteousness & justice to young males who are moving towards manhood.

Mr. Ward, the President of the Pearson Foundation, has a number of different tasks for us to do on a daily basis. The tasks that I have gotten a chance to do over the summer are cleaning the inside of the building, painting a room, staining stairways, constructing appliances, maintaining the outside of the building on a daily basis. I spent 30+ hours over the summer volunteering my time while working & doing an internship. I still continue to give my time to the Pearson Foundation throughout my time in school. 

When school started I have been able to help the Pearson Foundation with painting doors, help construct a fence around the land, clean the inside of the building, rake leaves, and maintain the perimeter of the building. I have put in 15+ hours this semester while maintaining an internship & being a fulltime student.

projects.title: Mirror.ly
projects.description:
Coordinated with team members to construct a smart mirror running from Raspbian on a Raspberry Pi 3 B+, television monitor, & infrared frame.
Organized meetings to discuss ideas & verify final decisions on hardware & software impementations.
Programmed modules & altered plain text files to display unique functionalities.
